en.banana.hero.name: Nano Banana 2.1
en.banana.hero.heading: AI Image Generator
en.banana.hero.intro: Turn an idea into an image. Write a prompt, bring your references, and choose the Nano Banana model that fits. Keep faces, products and the words in your picture in focus.
en.banana.intro.title: What is Nano Banana 2.1?
en.banana.intro.body: Nano Banana 2.1 creates and edits images from text and references. Write a prompt, upload references for an edit, and choose Nano Banana 2.1, 2, Pro or Lite. The workbench shows the credit cost before every request.
en.banana.steps.title: How to make an image with the Nano Banana 2.1 generator
en.banana.steps.intro: Describe the idea, add references, choose your settings, and review the result.
en.banana.steps.0.title: Describe the image
en.banana.steps.0.body: Start with the subject, then add the setting, lighting and style. Put exact words in quotes and say where they belong.
en.banana.steps.1.title: Bring your references
en.banana.steps.1.body: Switch to Image to image and choose your photos. Name each reference in the prompt so the model knows what to preserve.
en.banana.steps.2.title: Choose a model and shape
en.banana.steps.2.body: Choose 2.1, 2, Pro or Lite. Pick an available aspect ratio and check the model’s status and credit quote before running.
en.banana.steps.3.title: Review and download
en.banana.steps.3.body: Inspect the finished image beside your prompt. Check faces, product details and spelling, then download or continue editing.
en.banana.cases.title: What you can make with Nano Banana
en.banana.cases.intro: Product scenes, consistent characters, localized packaging and social images.
en.banana.cases.0.title: Online shops: put the product in a styled scene
en.banana.cases.0.body: Build a product brief around the real object. Use references for shape, label and color, then describe the surface and props.
en.banana.cases.0.alt: Original comparison of a yellow dropper bottle on white and in a limestone product scene
en.banana.cases.1.title: Storyboards: one character, several scenes
en.banana.cases.1.body: Reuse a character reference across a series. Change the action and setting while checking the face and outfit each time.
en.banana.cases.1.alt: Original photographic contact sheet of the same woman with a straight dark bob, navy jacket and cream top across four scenes
en.banana.cases.2.title: Packaging: adapt the words and keep the design
en.banana.cases.2.body: Provide the original packaging and translated copy. Ask for the same layout, then manually verify every translated label.
en.banana.cases.2.alt: Original matching cream and yellow banana snack pouches with English and French lettering
en.banana.cases.3.title: Social images: the shape your channel needs
en.banana.cases.3.body: Prepare a square post, a portrait story or a wide cover. Keep the subject and important text away from crop edges.
en.banana.cases.3.alt: Original banana and blueberry breakfast campaign composed for square, portrait and landscape social covers

zh.banana.hero.badge: Nano Banana 2.1 · 同一个工作空间里的 2、Pro 和 Lite
zh.banana.hero.name: Nano Banana 2.1
zh.banana.hero.heading: AI 图片生成器
zh.banana.hero.intro: 将创意变成图片。输入提示词、添加参考图，选择适合的 Nano Banana 模型，让人物、产品与画面中的文字更贴近你的想法。
zh.banana.intro.title: 什么是 Nano Banana 2.1？
zh.banana.intro.body: Nano Banana 2.1 支持文字生图和参考图编辑。写好提示词，编辑时上传参考图，再选择 2.1、2、Pro 或 Lite。工作台会在提交前显示本次所需积分。
zh.banana.intro.tags: 产品图|人物一致性|社媒封面|文字海报|科学图解|标志概念
zh.banana.steps.title: 如何使用 Nano Banana 2.1 图片生成器
zh.banana.steps.intro: 描述创意、添加参考、选择设置，然后检查结果。
zh.banana.steps.0.title: 描述你想要的图片
zh.banana.steps.0.body: 先描述主体，再补充场景、光线和风格。需要出现在画面里的文字请用引号括起，并说明位置。
zh.banana.steps.1.title: 添加参考图片
zh.banana.steps.1.body: 切换到图生图并选择照片。在提示词中说明每张参考图的作用，让模型理解需要保留的部分。
zh.banana.steps.2.title: 选择模型与画幅
zh.banana.steps.2.body: 选择 2.1、2、Pro 或 Lite，再选择支持的画幅。运行前检查模型状态与积分报价。
zh.banana.steps.3.title: 检查并下载
zh.banana.steps.3.body: 在提示词旁检查成图，核对人物、产品细节和文字，再下载或继续编辑。
zh.banana.cases.title: 用 Nano Banana 可以创作什么
zh.banana.cases.intro: 产品场景、一致角色、多语言包装，以及社交媒体图片。
zh.banana.cases.0.title: 电商图片：为产品搭建场景
zh.banana.cases.0.body: 围绕真实产品组织任务，用参考图明确形状、标签与颜色，再描述材质和道具。
zh.banana.cases.0.alt: 原创黄色滴管瓶白底照与石灰岩产品场景对比
zh.banana.cases.1.title: 分镜创作：同一个角色，不同场景
zh.banana.cases.1.body: 在系列图片中重复使用角色参考，改变动作与环境，同时逐张检查面容和服装。
zh.banana.cases.1.alt: 原创人物照片集：同一位短直发、穿深蓝外套和米白上衣的女性出现在四个场景
zh.banana.cases.2.title: 包装设计：调整文字，保留视觉风格
zh.banana.cases.2.body: 提供原包装和翻译文案，要求保留原有布局，再人工核对每个标签的翻译。
zh.banana.cases.2.alt: 原创奶油色与黄色香蕉零食包装，展示相同设计的英文和法文标签
zh.banana.cases.3.title: 社交图片：适配发布平台的画幅
zh.banana.cases.3.body: 准备方形帖子、竖屏故事或横向封面，让主体与重要文字避开裁切边缘。
zh.banana.cases.3.alt: 原创香蕉蓝莓早餐照片，展示方形、竖版与横版社交封面构图
zh.banana.cases.caption: 示意作品，使用前请检查生成结果；这些图片不是模型性能测试。
zh.banana.features.heading: Nano Banana 2.1 的三大创作能力
zh.banana.features.subtitle: 通过实例了解参考图、文字和画幅。
zh.banana.features.caption: 示意作品，使用前请检查生成结果。
zh.banana.features.references.title: 最多融合 {count} 张参考图，创作完整画面
zh.banana.features.references.body: 先准备人物、宠物或产品的参考图，让想保留的主体有明确依据。说明哪些内容需要改变，哪些应该保持：面孔、服装、颜色或外形。在编辑器中整理参考图，再查看所选模型是否可用，决定是否开始生成。
zh.banana.features.references.alt: 原创参考图组合：卷发女性、奶油色小狗和黄色水瓶合成阳光客厅照片
zh.banana.features.text.title: 让画面中的文字清晰可读
zh.banana.features.text.body: 咖啡海报、商品标签或邀请函，都需要准确易读的文字。把标题原文放在引号里，说明字体和排版，并在四周保留空白。从明确的海报提示词开始；拿到成品后，逐字核对，再用于发布或印刷。
zh.banana.features.text.alt: 原创黄色与象牙白咖啡海报，清晰的 FRESH COFFEE 黑色文字和黄色咖啡杯
zh.banana.features.ratios.title: 灵活画幅，最高 4K
zh.banana.features.ratios.body: 选择正方形、竖版或横版构图。可选比例与分辨率（包括 4K）取决于所选模型；生成前请检查输出设置。
zh.banana.features.ratios.alt: 原创黄色水瓶摄影，展示方形、横版和竖版构图
zh.banana.studio_description: 通过对话描述你的想法，并持续完善创作。

characterReplacement.description: One new fictional woman with a straight dark bob and navy jacket across the original four scenes. Owner-requested replacement; same 1280x720 layout.

notes: undefined Owner approved the four photographic capability cards on 2026-10-12. All other protected source/copy and eight non-target component functions preserved. Final desktop/mobile CSS visual review and 21 browser cases passed; source labels moved below artwork to avoid obscuring subjects. See docs/capability-gallery-redesign.md.

modelIconUnification.review: Owner requested execution of the shared model-brand plan. CUA reviewed neutral containers, native brand marks, 40/32px tiles and keyboard model selection. Only model icon rendering changes; composition, photos, copy, parameter and pricing logic remain unchanged.

productFactsReview.authorization: Owner requested execution of the factual consistency and evidence plan
productFactsReview.visualEvidence: .artifacts/product-evidence: 36 fixed-width iframe layout/theme cases (6 EN/ZH pages × 3 measured widths × 2 themes); reviewed pricing/features screenshots. Browser viewport override was ineffective, so these are layout checks, not real-device tests.
productFactsReview.artwork: All existing approved asset hashes unchanged

creditPackOffer.authorization: Owner requested the existing five-second offer include the other primary plans and approved the two-group implementation plan
creditPackOffer.behavior: Visible-tab five-second delay on every homepage entry, current-visit dismissal, keyboard-accessible credit-pack and subscription selectors, server-catalog pricing and selected-product checkout handoff
creditPackOffer.review: .artifacts/plan-offer: reviewed 672px desktop and 390px mobile dialog, all six checkout URLs, keyboard selection, measured delay, viewport containment and zero browser console errors

homepageSubscriptionPlans.authorization: Owner requested subscription plans also appear on the homepage
homepageSubscriptionPlans.behavior: Both groups render in sequence on the homepage; the standalone pricing page keeps its tabs and prepaid group
homepageSubscriptionPlans.review: .artifacts/home-subscriptions: 1440px and 390px screenshots, six expected prices, no page overflow, failed responses or console errors
